text:
Institutional DeFi needs a common language for risk. Our new report with Clear Street sets one out.

A Framework for Decomposing DeFi Risk in the Age of AI is led by Re7 Founder and CIO Evgeny Gokhberg and built on our own methodology. It breaks exposure into chain, protocol and asset layers.

The reason for the split is practical. A single aggregate view of a DeFi position tends to blur where the exposure actually sits. Two allocations can look alike at portfolio level while depending on different chains, different protocols and different assets. Decomposing them makes those dependencies visible and comparable.

The report also explores how AI is reshaping risk monitoring, and what that changes for teams overseeing on-chain exposure.

We are grateful to Clear Street for the collaboration, and see shared frameworks like this as part of the infrastructure institutional DeFi still needs.

The report is linked in the comments.
